statute.name: Orinth Criminal Code 2026
elements: A structured criminal syndicate existed and committed serious offences.
The accused knowingly directed or controlled the syndicate’s criminal activities.
The accused intended to advance those criminal activities.

agreed_facts: The Grey Quay Circle was a structured group with continuing roles and committed the serious offences described in the agreed records.
Celis heard the controlled phrase during the recorded interview, held the only issued cabinet key, and entered her office before the disputed order was received.
disputed_facts: Whether Celis or another person activated the signing key.
Whether any act by Celis was lawful mediation or intentional direction of the Circle's criminal activity.
What weight can be placed on the visitor sheet after the limited-purpose ruling.

best_case.prosecution: The contained phrase, physical-key custody, badge chronology, authenticated order and its coercive words combine to prove that Celis knowingly directed the Circle.
best_case.defence: The phrase was not exclusive, the device cannot identify a hand, access was not proved exclusive, lawful work explains possession, and the complete client note supports an innocent purpose.

alternative_innocent_inference: A person with unrecorded access or one of the other people who knew the phrase used Celis's lawful settlement key, while Celis's own work remained an attempt to stop threats and release stock.
required_directions: The prosecution must prove each element beyond reasonable doubt; Celis does not have to identify another sender.
Mere association, financial knowledge, lawful mediation or advice is not direction of criminal activity.
Circumstantial evidence may be combined, but each link and its limitations must be tested.
Use the visitor-sheet entries only to understand the examiner's testing choice, not to prove Celis alone entered the office.

checks.victim_humanity: Sava's partner, staff, lost stock, injuries and recovery remain concrete without graphic detail.
checks.accused_prejudice: The trial excludes punishment from the pre-verdict bundle and distinguishes Celis's lawful mediation practice from criminal direction.
